module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter DEPTH = 16,
    parameter WIDTH = 8,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable parameters WIDTH and DEPTH.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="WIDTH">FIFO data width.</param>
        <param id="DEPTH">FIFO depth.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="wen">winc & ~wfull;</assign>
        <assign id="ren">rinc & ~rempty;</assign>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Dual-port RAM instance
        dual_port_RAM #(.DEPTH(DEPTH), .WIDTH(WIDTH)) ram_inst (
            .wclk(wclk),
            .wenc(wen),
            .waddr(waddr),
            .wdata(wdata),
            .rclk(rclk),
            .renc(ren),
            .raddr(raddr),
            .rdata(rdata)
        );
        // Write Pointer Logic
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] waddr_bin;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr;
        
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
                wptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (winc && !wfull) begin
                    waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
                    wptr <= {wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)], ^wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]};
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Read Pointer Logic
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] raddr_bin;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] rptr;
        
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
                rptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                    raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
                    rptr <= {rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)], ^rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]};
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Gray Code Conversion
        wire [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr_gray;
        wire [$clog2(DEPTH):0] rptr_gray;
        
        assign wptr_gray = wptr ^ (wptr >> 1);
        assign rptr_gray = rptr ^ (rptr >> 1);
        
        // Buffer Registers
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr_buff;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] rptr_buff;
        
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr_gray;
            end
        end
        
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr_gray;
            end
        end
        
        // Full and Empty Signal Generation
        wire [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr_syn;
        wire [$clog2(DEPTH):0] rptr_syn;
        
        assign wptr_syn = wptr_buff ^ (wptr_buff >> 1);
        assign rptr_syn = rptr_buff ^ (rptr_buff >> 1);
        
        assign wfull = (wptr == {~rptr_syn[$clog2(DEPTH)], rptr_syn[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]});
        assign rempty = (rptr == wptr_syn);
        
        // Assigning Outputs
        assign waddr = waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];
        assign raddr = raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];
    </implementation>
    
    <task>
        <description>Task to implement the dual-port RAM functionality.</description>
        <step>Instantiate the dual-port RAM module with specified parameters.</step>
        <step>Connect the appropriate signals between the main module and the instantiated RAM module.</step>
        <step>Ensure proper synchronization between the write and read operations.</step>
        <step>Handle the full and empty conditions based on the comparison of pointers.</step>
    </task>
</module>
